comparison.objective: Candidate locks an adjusted gripper stop; PR-1935 couples a scaffold transom to a ledger.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening a thin jam nut; PR-1935 positions a transom, closes a cap, swings a bolt into a slot, and runs down its nut.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies angular repeatability after cycling; PR-1935 verifies placement, cap/bolt closure, nut bearing, and resistance to a pull.
comparison.reason: Nut tightening is shared, but PR-1935 does not test preserving a coupled precision setting against tightening reaction.
